name: D1 score/MoU calibration and mask-support complementarity audit
status: post-hoc protocol record; worker was fixed before execution but no separate protocol was frozen before the run
scope: Read only the 568 existing candidate-bank .pth artifacts from reports/d1_expansion_20260911-0715. Do not load a model, ScanRefer sample, checkpoint, or optimizer; do not run inference or training; do not allocate CUDA.

definitions.strata: success if IoU_oracle > 0.5 and IoU_selected > 0.5; recoverable if IoU_oracle > 0.5 and IoU_selected <= 0.5; bank_failure if IoU_oracle <= 0.5
definitions.rank_fusion: equal rank-sum of p_q and A_bin(q), an exploratory complementarity probe only

hypotheses: H1: the saved indis score has weaker rank agreement with candidate IoU on recoverable banks than on successful banks.
H2: a simple mask-area proxy or equal rank fusion is not sufficient to recover the oracle.
primary_readouts: Spearman and Kendall tau-b between p_q and IoU_q
binary and continuous NDCG of the score ordering
oracle membership in the score top-5
same metrics for soft_area and binary_area
exploratory equal rank fusion top-5 oracle membership
rejection_if: H1 is false: recoverable score/IoU rank agreement is not materially below the success stratum.
H2 is false: a simple fixed mask-support proxy or rank fusion already recovers the oracle at a materially useful rate.
limitations: The saved indis score is a classifier logit, not a calibrated mask-quality posterior.
The diagnostic is descriptive and cannot establish a causal scoring mechanism.
The rank fusion probe is equal-weight and exploratory; it is not a proposed deployable reranker.
No new data, annotation, model forward pass, or efficiency claim is produced.
